channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191 highlights
item.description:
• /rewind can resume conversation from before /clear (v2.1.191)
  • Sandbox: allowed network hosts remembered for rest of session (v2.1.191)
  • MCP OAuth: headless skips browser popup; retries on transient errors (v2.1.191)
  • MCP capability discovery retries transient network errors (v2.1.191)
  • sandbox.credentials blocks sandboxed commands from reading secrets (v2.1.187)
  • Org-configured model restrictions in model picker, --model, ANTHROPIC_MODEL (v2.1.187)
  • claude mcp login/logout authenticate MCP servers from CLI (v2.1.186)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.191
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /rewind: Rewind conv / code checkpoint; resume from before /clear (/undo alias)

Full changelog

• Added `/rewind` support for resuming a conversation from before `/clear` was run
• Fixed scroll position jumping to the bottom while reading earlier output during a streaming response
• Fixed background agents resurrecting after being stopped — stopping an agent from the tasks panel is now permanent
• Fixed `/voice` showing a generic "not available" message when disabled by an organization's policy — it now explains the restriction
• Fixed `/login` URL opening truncated in Windows Terminal when it wraps across lines
• Fixed Cmd+click on links in fullscreen mode for Ghostty over ssh/tmux
• Fixed `claude agents` sending builtin slash commands like `/usage` to background sessions as prompt text instead of showing a hint
• Fixed `claude agents` job rows showing full filesystem paths for pasted images instead of the `[Image #N]` placeholder
• Fixed hooks with comma-separated matchers (e.g. `"Bash,PowerShell"`) silently never firing
• Fixed `/permissions` Recently-denied tab: approving a denial now persists on close instead of being silently discarded
• Fixed the agent panel jumping by one row when scrolling the roster past the overflow cap
• Fixed the welcome splash art overflowing the default 80×24 macOS Terminal window
• Fixed managed settings: `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` now takes effect when set via MDM or file policy, and the fetch sends `Cache-Control: no-cache` to prevent proxies from serving stale responses
• Improved sandbox network permission dialog: hosts you allow with "Yes" are now remembered for the rest of the session instead of re-prompting on every connection
• Improved MCP server reliability: capability discovery (`tools/list`, `prompts/list`, `resources/list`) now retries transient network errors with short backoff
• Improved MCP OAuth: discovery and token requests now retry once after transient network errors, and headless environments skip the browser popup and go straight to the paste-the-URL prompt
• Improved MCP error messages: HTTP 404 errors now show the URL and point to your MCP config
• Improved vim mode prompt-history search (NORMAL `/`) to hint how to reach slash commands
• Reduced CPU usage during streaming responses by ~37% by coalescing text updates to 100ms
• Reduced long-session memory growth from terminal output cache

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.187
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.credentials: Block sandboxed commands from reading credential files and secret env vars
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_TOOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Override 5-min idle timeout for remote MCP tool calls
~ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_MODEL: Default model; org restrictions can override
~ [slash-commands] /btw <question>: Side question (no context); ←/→ step through earlier answers
- [config-env] awsAuthRefresh
- [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.186
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp login <name>: Authenticate MCP server from CLI; --no-browser for SSH
+ [mcp-servers] claude mcp logout <name>: Revoke MCP server authentication from CLI
+ [config-env] teammateMode: "iterm2": Use iTerm2 backend for agent teams; warns if it2 CLI missing
+ [config-env] respondToBashCommands: false keeps ! bash output as context only (default: Claude responds)
+ [config-env] awsAuthRefresh: Adds AWS credential refresh option to /login (managed)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES: Max API retries (caps at 15); use RETRY_WATCHDOG for unattended
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG: Alternative retry cap for unattended/headless sessions
~ [keyboard-shortcuts] !: Direct bash; Claude responds to output (respondToBashCommands: false disables)
~ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs; press f to filter status
- [config-env] language
- [config-env] enforceAvailableModels
- [config-env] allowManagedHooksOnly
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183
item.description:

- [config-env] footerLinksRegexes

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.181
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents: Opt-in: let sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE: Marker file to suppress push notifications while at the machine
~ [slash-commands] /config: Open settings; key=value sets any setting
- [config-env] OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
- [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.178
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/skills: Nested skill dirs load; clashes show as <dir>:<name>
+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/ priority: Agent/workflow/output-style closest to cwd wins on collision
~ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all; Tool(param:value) matches input params; allow rejects non-MCP
~ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Explicit phrases only ('run a workflow', 'workflow:'); purple shimmer
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates tens–hundreds of agents; triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.169
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --safe-mode: Start with all customizations disabled (CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE: Env var equivalent of --safe-mode flag
+ [slash-commands] /cd [path]: Move session to new working directory without breaking prompt cache
+ [config-env] disableBundledSkills: Hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from model
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS: Env var equivalent of disableBundledSkills setting
+ [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Opt out of default 5min idle timeout on Vertex/Foundry (set to 0)
~ [cli-flags] claude agents --json: List live sessions as JSON; --all includes completed; id/state fields
- [config-env] MessageDisplay
- [config-env] reloadSkills
- [config-env] sessionTitle
- [config-env] WorktreeCreate

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.166
item.description:

+ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all tools; allow rules reject non-MCP globs
+ [cli-flags] --thinking: disabled turns off thinking on models that think by default
~ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Fallback when primary unavailable (interactive + headless)
~ [config-env] MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: 0=off; disables thinking on models that think by default
- [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces
- [config-env] allowAllClaudeAiMcps

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.163
item.description:

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.154
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←←: Open agents view
+ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs
+ [slash-commands] /chrome: Select connected browser for Chrome integration
+ [slash-commands] /logout: Sign out (in agents view)
+ [cli-flags] claude --bg --exec '<cmd>': Run shell command as attachable background session
+ [config-env] defaultEnabled: Plugin default disabled in plugin.json; enable with /plugin
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses
+ [skills-agents] /simplify: Cleanup-only review (reuse, simplify, efficiency, altitude) and apply fixes
+ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Ask Claude to create; orchestrates tens to hundreds of agents
~ [slash-commands] /effort [level]: Set effort; interactive slider (low–max; Faster/Smarter labels)
~ [skills-agents] Workflow: Dynamic multi-agent orchestration (opt-in); /workflows to view runs
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] /effort: ○ low · ◐ med · ◑ xhigh · ● high/max (Faster↔Smarter)
~ [mcp-servers] claude mcp list: List all servers (⏸ = pending approval)
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+U
- [slash-commands] /scroll-speed
- [slash-commands] /color [color]
- [slash-commands] /tui [fullscreen]
- [cli-flags] --channels
- [config-env] worktree.baseRef
- [config-env] OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT
